description: Source code for a mock voice call provider class used for local testing, handling webhook events, and simulating call status.

classes.name: MockProvider
classes.description: A mock implementation of the VoiceCallProvider interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: verifyWebhook
methods.description: Verifies webhook authenticity, always returns true.

methods.name: parseWebhookEvent
methods.description: Parses incoming webhook JSON payload into normalized events.

methods.name: normalizeEvent
methods.description: Converts partial event data into a normalized event object based on event type.

methods.name: initiateCall
methods.description: Simulates initiating a call, returns mock call ID and status.

methods.name: hangupCall
methods.description: Mock method for hanging up a call, no operation.

methods.name: playTts
methods.description: Mock method for playing text-to-speech, no operation.

methods.name: startListening
methods.description: Mock method to start listening, no operation.

methods.name: stopListening
methods.description: Mock method to stop listening, no operation.

methods.name: getCallStatus
methods.description: Returns mock call status based on providerCallId.
